quotes.text: With Mapbox or Google Maps I wouldn't even have considered building this game. Protomaps made it a no-brainer.
quotes.author: thatslast
quotes.source: Hacker News — Protomaps: Self-hosting map tiles has gotten cheap and easy
quotes.extraction_note: Crisp, standalone point about how cloud pricing gateskeep ideas — the rest of the comment was context/fluff about the game itself.
